hints: Acceleration is the slope of the v–t graph. Which segment is steepest?
worded:
1. Acceleration is the slope of each straight segment.

2. 0–20 s: 20 cm/s in 20 s, slope 1. 20–30 s: flat, 0. 30–40 s: 60 cm/s in 10 s, slope 6. 40–80 s: −80 in 40 s, slope −2.

3. Steepest rise: 6 cm/s². (D)
conventional:
![](asset:P000162-sol-1)

$$a_{30 - 40} = \frac{80 - 20}{40 - 30} = 6\ {cm/s}^{2},$$

the largest of the slopes 1, 0, 6 and −2 cm/s².
mistakes: Read the steepness, not the height: the highest point (80 cm/s) is not where the acceleration is largest.
Units are cm/s and s, so the answer is in cm/s².
